title: Corrected interpretation of R106 pointer images

evidence_source.kind: offline visual reinspection of existing MAME screenshots; no guest input

correction.supersedes: The R106 interpretation that one counter produced only a small local pointer displacement.
correction.observed: The pointer starts clipped at the left screen edge, appears over the File Name text after one counter image, and appears in the lower-left panel region after the 20-step image.
correction.interpretation: The changed pixel count is small because the pointer glyph occupies few pixels; it does not measure travel distance. The text caret and mouse pointer are distinct.
correction.consequence: Relative counters are nonlocal in this session and are not suitable for precise text selection.

remaining: Do not send more relative counters to target the field.
Continue only the authorized GTK2 item with existing valid implementation evidence.
A paired native SR10.4 selection capture needs a precise, verified input route; selection appearance remains unproven.
